title: Label smoothing hurts perplexity
description: The paper reports that using label smoothing of value 0.1 during training hurts perplexity because the model learns to be more unsure, though this trade-off improves accuracy and BLEU score.
canonical_description: label smoothing degrades perplexity while improving task accuracy

evidence.quote: This hurts perplexity, as the model learns to be more unsure, but improves accuracy and BLEU score.
